name: Smash Therapy

# Welcome to Smash Therapy – The Ultimate VR Smash Experience!

Feeling stressed? Need to let off some steam? Smash Therapy is your ticket to a world of fun, chaotic destruction! Step into the shoes of everyday workers tackling their chores, but with a twist. Smash, bash, and wreck your way through vibrant cartoonish environments, each packed with destructible objects just waiting for your outburst.
